status: Comparative tied genuine inner arch; slide fit, window/guard and renewal must all be paid for

slidePost.seizedControl: A seized bearing under the corner displacement interrupts the tied arch mechanism; friction cannot be silently assumed zero.

window.comparedOccurrence: FIRST outer-north north-window-0; hard obstruction would also affect the four outside corner pairs
window.meaning: Separate operable lower cassette and bead-removable fixed fanlight on independent frame. Existing tall leaf/guard/jamb release no longer transfers; the fixed transom stays when both panes/sashes are removed. Installed glass make-up, frame/edge rebate, safe staging and weather are additional burdens.

movement.caveat: Actual roof diaphragm and real foundation stiffness still control; no credit for bonded plaster, glass or a stuck shoe. The budget is not a guarantee of workmanship, temperature, settlement or seismic travel.

shoes.leftDatum: Sliding at the near RC toe; centre of the 230 long fixed bed is1115. Sleeve length66 around a16 pin and25 either-side allowance. Opposed guides capture transverse load; do not add longitudinal restraint at this end.
shoes.oppositeDatum: Right spring shoe/bed mirrors the left about1800 but fixes horizontal position in the opposite jamb; horizontal component closes through permanent40x12 tie at2510. Vertical reaction at both cheeks bears on mineral/steel pads, never on glazing.
shoes.permanentShoringCost: To renew a buried shoe/slider, both arch reactions must be taken by temporary works before tie or bearing disturbance. No such completed installation/withdrawal scheme is claimed. Lower glass and bead-removed fanlight may be independent but replacing the entire existing arched cassette/outer guard across the permanent structural band is not a retained event.

decision: Reject importing the fixed-band tied arch as the unchanged whole-house opening family. Local arch and movement arithmetic is plausible but it loses the full-height window/guard/rare passage and hides a shoring-dependent wearing interface. Compare a real load-bearing integral curved RC inner ring with genuine outer masonry and an independently replaceable window; that RC option still needs its coupled pier and both-jamb stiffness/forces, not a boxed lintel.
